title: Felix and the Colony
author: Wendell Whitlock
blurb: Orsen Hartwell, the caretaker of Earth's abandoned seed vault, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. Then an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
